Possible-recipient source dispositions avoid the proposed token cycle, and a fixed conditional rule can have different recipient-relative applications. The two-good source-constitution and cognitive-recognition burdens remain open. The 2026-11-25 standard-priority investigation in draft #1998 distinguishes independence from produced verdicts from ontically external dependence. It develops a positive intrinsic constitution at the same source scope, performs the preserved-content parity correction, and identifies the actual independent-ground and inclusive-sufficiency premises needed for an external-standard objection. Objective goodness alone does not supply source apprehension or operative uptake. This new scoped assessment preserves the due/unrestricted and source-esse findings; no formal meaning, warrant of those propositions, support edge or premise discharge changes. The improvement-versus-positivity test in docs/notes/root-esse-goodness-prd.md grants an independently fixed success criterion and identical rankings of restoration for one existing bearer. Two zero-axiom local checks distinguish meeting a requirement neutrally from realizing a positive excellence at that very respect. The forward esse instance used by 0011703b requires an evaluative constitutive bridge at the same source; nonexistence provides no defective state of that same subject. No new formal status or moral attribution. Owner selected a proposition, superseding adopted-definition proposal (#1116). Encoded due-actuality coextension over typed forms/ends/perfections, a structural surplus/omission fork under explicit excluded middle, and separate philosophical named coverage with an explicit additional-definition alternative. Core elimination uses weak pointwise-coextension coverage, one correct admissible account and actual failures of feature/approval accounts; stronger candidate-ID coverage is preserved with a certified strength relation. Fixed models witness all structural cells, their overlap, a genuinely extension-different fourth account, and failure of deriving the target from only the two named failures. The new thesis yields the old unrestricted root leaf exactly with AllActualitiesDue; a non-due actual knife mass prevents silently identifying them. Boyd positive-case aspect-transfer instances occupy all three cells under fixed nonempty criteria; Railton welfare-aspect instances survive or fail depending on the supplied interest criterion. These are explicit schema transfers, not source attributions or full historical-theory defeats. Existing exact-classifier proof is imported; coarse data fail and form-sensitive classification survives. Property identity is stronger than coextension; no Moore simplicity/indefinability verdict is inferred. Details, rejected alias-based coverage shortcut, fixed witnesses and encoding gaps persist in docs/notes/goodness-form-end-definitions.md. Registered the exact two-premise bridge to the existing unrestricted route leaf rather than hiding it in a certificate. This exposes the proposed thesis, semantic coverage, correct-account and rival-failure commitments, and AllActualitiesDue on the reaching-root frontier; the computed delta reports them honestly. This is conditional configuration progress, not a reduction in bare premises. Outside-disambiguation consequential-use audit found a further sufficient support weakening: classify some correct admissible account rather than every admissible proposal. New CorrectAccountSupport is conditional on old correct-account existence and may transfer to a different witness. Global semantic coverage strengthens it; weaker elimination composes the unchanged old theorem on a singleton-admissibility restriction; a widened original artifact space retains a correct named .due and wrong admissible extension-unnamed .other plus every weaker input while global coverage fails. Property identity/source claims/old Challenges remain unchanged. Full79 definition dispositions and exact consumer/type boundaries persist in docs/notes/truth-definition-use-audit.md and its linked JSON. Computed comparison at base f6347d273ba44bd4a99098e6c9a2b25f8ed0813d: reaching-root open premises126→127, adding the bare CorrectAccountSupport input; cheapest adopted-potency route30→30. This exposes a separate weaker sufficient configuration, not a premise discharge or frontier-count reduction. P1 correction discussion4497633832: initial doc disclaimer about correct proposals was false. Added checked equivalence of conditional support and semantic named coverage of EVERY admissible CORRECT account on the SAME dictionary; coextension through GoodIn transports membership. The .other strictness witness is explicitly WRONG, so only arbitrary-admissible coverage is separated. No new OPEN/root premise or old Challenge change. Further bounded ideal-consensus comparison: unanimous ideal approval is compatible with due goodness under explicit universal acceptance and an aspectwise sound-assessor witness. Existing artifact controls omit each bridge separately, and an empty-assessor case exposes vacuous unanimity. No real idealization or practical authority follows; details and rejected inferences are preserved in the existing note.

#2103 coverage audit at 632e76a81. (a) GoodnessDueToUnrestricted.dueToUnrestricted (3b3495cb, argument f2ad40c3) derives 00e962ae from due actuality 6cc47d1b and universal due coverage 76f32b56 on the same frame. It gives coextension at a respect without identifying a real ground of goodness. (c) The #1998 follow-up's noStrictCycle, cycleCensus, cycleClosure, and eligibilityOnEqualData are compiled in GoodnessStandardPriority, with no dedicated result. noStrictCycle uses transitivity and irreflexivity of ONE priority order and three edges between the same actual exercise A, constitution R and normative fact D. The edge-deletion controls permit noncyclic profiles. eligibilityOnEqualData applies the first conjunct of 0590fe21 at a fixed option; it requires exact classification of each option's eligibility by the supplied data. GovernanceEligibilityCensus.factors_iff, census, rows and consent compile the equal-data, tied-selection and consent projection tests. Different selections from a tied set do not establish different eligibility. A constant projection can omit the holder's consent even under one invariant rule.

(e) Original authority and actual source direction: the cycle applies only if D is a strict ground of A itself in the same order as A→R and R→D. Distinguish the directed exercise from its downstream beneficial description. For eligibility, identify a warranted variation in the identical option at equal genuinely complete source data, then determine whether its additional ground is independent or a produced circumstance under a fixed rule. The metaphysical application from objective recipient good to an external standard, or from operative direction to the source's actual apprehension, has no corresponding registered proof. The live consumers remain 29818edd and 66aecdd7 via the full 11628966/dd55f57a bundles, and 785a4e63/e8ca49db given actual operative specification. Neither rule exactness nor the compiled order census provides any edge of an actual metaphysical cycle. Positive intrinsic constitution and primitive priority alternatives retain their previous assessment.

current_assessment.scope: Whether an objectively good-directed original source must receive its standard from an ontically prior reality; constitutive goodness and normative independence under the matched necessary, simple, invariant, nonnecessitating concrete-source comparison. This does not reassess all due-actuality or unrestricted goodness claims, original jurisdiction, or the complete worldviews. Expanded by owner comment 7169154319 to actual normative specification, the downstream token-norm cycle, exact per-option intrinsic-data sufficiency, and a positive joint source constitution for epistemic and directed moral goods.
current_assessment.assessment: Independence of a standard from whichever verdict is produced does not establish an ontically external standard. A positive intrinsic proposal treats one productive actuality as essentially recipient-perfecting, with genuine rational fulfillment and jointly required relations, rather than making whatever occurs good. Local due perfection alone does not supply original productive finality: the actual exercise must manifest that positive nature. The external-standard objection succeeds conditionally with an independent standard, a real constitutive or explanatory dependence, and an inclusive source-sufficiency claim excluding it; that dependence has not been established for the strongest intrinsic rival. A personal constitution has a distinctive account of apprehended practical specification, but cognition alone neither makes the object good nor proves its actual guidance. The executed pair-count correction excludes output-indexed correctness and leaves both stronger constitutions available for further assessment. No full ultimate realization, global explanatory equivalence, strongest-rival defeat or premise discharge is claimed. The due/unrestricted bridge retains AllActualitiesDue; ActualRoot retains its actual-concrete relation-relative scope. The follow-up gives a substantive conditional failure of A-to-R-to-D-to-A grounding when the same facts inhabit one justified transitive irreflexive order. A-to-R-to-D-to-Beneficial(A) is not that cycle; direction toward a possible recipient good need not receive its specification from an actual downstream token norm. The factorization application tests exact completeness for each fixed eligibility fact, not intrinsic rulehood, actual selection or ultimacy alone. The consent case defeats a consent-omitting projection under retained standing premises, not the source; no actual varying-norm witness against the strongest intrinsic account was obtained. Positive unity must realize the cognitive and normative bases jointly. Warranted full pure-wisdom and recognition bundles would exclude noncognition, but generic possession, recipient cognition and knowledge of actual effects do not establish the possible-exemplar or operative-direction application.
current_assessment.next_test: Fix one actual source and one shared positive source profile for the two recipient goods: truth-directed uptake and original directed standing. Substantiate its own disposition to the good of possible recipients and its actual productive exercise, or identify an indispensable independent supplier. For the cycle exclusion, establish the return-dependence of the same actual exercise and a justified common strict order; appraisal alone is insufficient. For the completeness exclusion, defend the complete-data claim and genuinely admitted profiles before showing a same-option eligibility difference; variation under one conditional rule is insufficient. Apply existing whole-power/pure-wisdom and cognitive-recognition bundles only with all premises at the same n, and separately warrant possible-exemplar coverage and practical uptake. Do not rerun the completed finite counts as substitutes for these application tests.
